title: verify harness: the requires knowledge case (no libSQL store) times out at vitest's 5000 ms default in the full run and turns the 4-hourly CI on main red
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filing gate: ② CI finding on `main` · Source: triage, reading the 4-hourly full run 45888214247 (schedule, 20:03Z), job "Test Core (10/10)" 140145134703. Follows the generated main-red card #37636.

Triage: lands in area:ai · domain:server · Bug · priority:p1 · `pm:queue` · size XS; rationale: a timing flake that turns the full run on `main` red is p1. This is the second distinct cause on #37636 today; the first is #37494 (sqlite-wasm, p1).

## What happens

```
FAIL packages/verify/src/harness.required-providers.test.ts > requires: ['knowledge'] — the knowledge service and one store
     > an install without the optional libSQL store: the service is constructed, the store is not, …
Error: Test timed out in 5000ms.
Tests 1 failed | 507 passed (508)
```

The case is new, from PR #37442 (feat(core): requires knowledge mounts the knowledge service and one vector store). It boots a stack and runs under vitest's 5000 ms default. On the loaded last shard of the full battery, the boot overruns. The push and merge-queue runs did not show it, because they run only the touched packages.

## Expected

- The case boots inside a budget that holds on a loaded runner: a per-case timeout sized from measurement, or a shared boot as #28631 did for server test files. It is not skipped.
- The next 4-hourly run is green on this file (and #37494's), and #37636 closes.

Related: #37636 (generated main-red card), #37494 (the other cause), #37000 (knowledge topic), PR #37442.

Blocked-by: none.
